scripts.script:
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

pcall(function()
    StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, true)
end)

if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("MobileKeyboard") then
    CoreGui.MobileKeyboard:Destroy()
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MobileKeyboard"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui

local function makeDraggable(guiObject)
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

    guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = guiObject.Position
            
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    guiObject.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, 
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
                startPos.Y.Scale, 
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)
end

KeyboardFrame.Name = "FullKeyboardPanel"

KeyboardFrame.ZIndex = 99

KeyboardFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local FrameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FrameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
FrameCorner.Parent = KeyboardFrame

makeDraggable(KeyboardFrame)

local function createKey(name, text, keyCode, sizeX, sizeY, posX, posY)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizeX, 0, sizeY)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, posX, 0, posY)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextSize = 11
    btn.ZIndex = 100
    btn.Active = true
    btn.Parent = KeyboardFrame
    
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    corner.Parent = btn
    
    if keyCode then
        btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 100)
        end)
        
        btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end)
        
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end)
    end
    return btn
end

local StickKnobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
StickKnobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
StickKnobCorner.Parent = StickKnob

local activeInput = nil
local knobCenter = Vector2.new(60, 60)
local maxDist = 35

local function resetMovement()
    activeInput = nil
    StickKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0.5, -20)
    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.W, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.S, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.A, false, game)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.D, false, game)
    end)
end

StickZone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and not activeInput then
        activeInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeInput then
        resetMovement()
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeInput and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local absPos = StickZone.AbsolutePosition
        local touchPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        local relPos = touchPos - absPos - knobCenter
        
        if relPos.Magnitude > maxDist then
            relPos = relPos.Unit * maxDist
        end
        
        StickKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, relPos.X - 20, 0.5, relPos.Y - 20)
        
        pcall(function()
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.Y < -8, Enum.KeyCode.W, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.Y > 8, Enum.KeyCode.S, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.X < -8, Enum.KeyCode.A, false, game)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(relPos.X > 8, Enum.KeyCode.D, false, game)
        end)
    end
end)

end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if isHoldingJump then
            local char = Player.Character
            if char then
                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid and humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
                    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)

local isOpen = false
ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isOpen = not isOpen
    KeyboardFrame.Visible = isOpen
    ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = isOpen and Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 150, 255)
end)

scripts.script:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
--[[
	REBRANDED & UPGRADED TO: DIVINE PANEL
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Clean up existing GUI if running again
if player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("DivineGUI") then
	player.PlayerGui.DivineGUI:Destroy()
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS
--------------------------------------------------
local saying = false
local targetName = "TMX"
local delayTime = 1
local pattern = "_"
local allowedPlayer = nil

-- Loop controller for movement commands
if _G.VivekMovementLoop then 
	_G.VivekMovementLoop:Disconnect() 
	_G.VivekMovementLoop = nil
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- RO MESSAGE LIST (TMX ROASTS)
--------------------------------------------------
local roMessages = {
	"TMX MEH FIRE 🔥","FYTER BNEGA?🤣","BCHE VIVEK ON TOP👑","TMX MEH Rocket 🚀",
	"TMX MEH electricity ⚡","TMX meh SURF 😆","Leave marde 🤣","mera beta ON TOP BOL 🔥",
	"TMX MEH BOOK 📚","Pil gya itni jaldi 🤣","Itna lallu fyter🤧","Divine bye Vivek👑",
	"Tmx meh petroleum","Dffn?😔","Bhag ja bache😹","Tmx meh dino 😈",
	"TMX MEH MAJDOOR","TMX MEH SCRIPT","TMX MEH TREE🌴","TMX MEH CLIP",
	"Tmx Allu🥔","TMX MEH GOAT","TMX MEH BLAZE","TMX MEH SALT",
	"TMX MEH ROD","TMX MEH UNIVERSE","TMX MEH SOFA",
	"TMX MEH KEYBOARD","TMX MEH SNIPER","this script ON TOP👑",
	"TMX MEH MONITOR","TMX MEH TABLE","TMX MEH GALAXLY",
	"TMX MEH MUSHROOM","TMX MEH STONE","TMX MEH BOT",
	"TMX MEH TAB","TMX MEH CYLINDER","TMX MEH KING",
	"TMX MEH VOID","TMX MEH REAPER","TMX MEH GOD",
	"TMX MEH MASTER","TMX MEH NOVA","TMX MEH BEAST",
	"TMX MEH LEGEND","TMX MEH GHOST","TMX MEH NINJA",
	"TMX MEH STAR","TMX MEH MOON","TMX MEH NEON",
	"TMX MEH OMEGA","TMX MEH STICK","TMX MEH PAPER",
	"TMX MEH STYLE","TMX MEH ALPHA","TMX MEH FISH"
}

--------------------------------------------------
-- GENERATE LINE
--------------------------------------------------
local function generateLine()
	local result = ""
	while #result < 150 do
		result = result .. pattern
	end
	return string.sub(result, 1, 150)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- SPAM SYSTEM
--------------------------------------------------
local function startROSpam()
	if saying then return end
	saying = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while saying do
			local msgText = roMessages[math.random(1, #roMessages)]
			local msg = generateLine().."\n"..targetName.."\n"..msgText
			
			pcall(function()
				TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(msg)
			end)
			task.wait(delayTime)
		end
	end)
end

local function stopAll()
	saying = false
	if _G.VivekMovementLoop then 
		_G.VivekMovementLoop:Disconnect() 
		_G.VivekMovementLoop = nil
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- COMMAND SYSTEM
--------------------------------------------------
local function handleCommand(speaker, message)
	if allowedPlayer and speaker.Name ~= allowedPlayer then return end

	local args = message:split(" ")
	local cmd = args[1]:lower()

	local commander = Players:FindFirstChild(speaker.Name)
	local commanderChar = commander and commander.Character
	local myChar = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	if cmd == "!ro" then
		if args[2] then targetName = args[2] end
		startROSpam()
	end

	if cmd == "!say" then
		if #args > 1 then
			local text = message:sub(6)
			pcall(function()
				TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(text)
			end)
		end
	end

	if cmd == "!bot" then
		local msg = generateLine().."\nH1 VIVEK RULER 👑"
		pcall(function()
			TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(msg)
		end)
	end

	if cmd == "!stop" then
		stopAll()
	end

	if cmd == "!delay" then
		local n = tonumber(args[2])
		if n then delayTime = n end
	end

	if cmd == "!pattern" then
		if args[2] then pattern = args[2] end
	end

	-- COMMAND: !assemble
	if cmd == "!assemble" then
		if commanderChar and commanderChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			stopAll()
			local bots = {}
			for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do table.insert(bots, p.Name) end
			table.sort(bots)
			local myIndex = 1
			for i, v in ipairs(bots) do
				if v == player.Name then myIndex = i break end
			end
			
			local gap = 4
			local startX = -((#bots * gap) / 2)
			local offsetX = startX + (myIndex * gap)
			myChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = commanderChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(offsetX, 0, 5)
		end
	end

	-- COMMAND: !ravan
	if cmd == "!ravan" then
		if commanderChar and commanderChar:FindFirstChild("Head") and myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			stopAll()
			local bots = {}
			for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do table.insert(bots, p.Name) end
			table.sort(bots)
			local myIndex = 1
			for i, v in ipairs(bots) do if v == player.Name then myIndex = i break end end

			_G.VivekMovementLoop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				if commanderChar and commanderChar:FindFirstChild("Head") and myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					local angle = (myIndex * (math.pi * 2 / #bots)) + (tick() * 3)
					local x = math.cos(angle) * 3
					local z = math.sin(angle) * 3
					myChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = commanderChar.Head.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, 0, z)
				else
					stopAll()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	-- COMMAND: !vivek
	if cmd == "!vivek" then
		if commanderChar and commanderChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			stopAll()
			_G.VivekMovementLoop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				if commanderChar and commanderChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					if math.random(1, 5) > 3 then 
						local rx = math.random(-25, 25)
						local ry = math.random(-5, 20)
						local rz = math.random(-25, 25)
						myChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = commanderChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(rx, ry, rz)
					end
				else
					stopAll()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	-- COMMAND: !vivekking
	if cmd == "!vivekking" then
		player:Kick("ban by Vivek")
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CHAT LISTENER
--------------------------------------------------
for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
		handleCommand(plr, msg)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
		handleCommand(plr, msg)
	end)
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- GUI CREATION
--------------------------------------------------
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DivineGUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

--------------------------------------------------
-- CINEMATIC INTRO
--------------------------------------------------
local introFrame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
introFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
introFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 5)

-- Phonk Sound

--[[

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local BIND_NAME = "LockOnCamera"
local MAX_RANGE = 400
local CAMERA_DISTANCE = 10
local CAMERA_HEIGHT = 3.2
local smoothness = 0.35

	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND_NAME)
end)
local oldGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("LockOnGui")
if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

local humanoidRootPart = nil

local savedAutoRotate = true

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
	humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if humanoid then
		savedAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate

end

end

local bar = Instance.new("TextButton")

bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22)

local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

handle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)

handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
handle.ZIndex = 2
handle.Parent = bar

local handleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
handleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
handleCorner.Parent = handle

local draggingWindow = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return
	end
	local pos = input.Position
	local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
	local abs = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - inset
	if track.AbsolutePosition.X <= abs.X and abs.X <= track.AbsolutePosition.X + track.AbsoluteSize.X
		and track.AbsolutePosition.Y <= abs.Y and abs.Y <= track.AbsolutePosition.Y + track.AbsoluteSize.Y then
		return
	end
	if bar.AbsolutePosition.X <= abs.X and abs.X <= bar.AbsolutePosition.X + bar.AbsoluteSize.X
		and bar.AbsolutePosition.Y <= abs.Y and abs.Y <= bar.AbsolutePosition.Y + bar.AbsoluteSize.Y then
		return
	end
	draggingWindow = true
	dragStart = pos
	startPos = main.Position
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not draggingWindow then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return
	end
	if not dragStart or not startPos then
		return
	end
	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	main.Position = UDim2.new(
		startPos.X.Scale,
		startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
		startPos.Y.Scale,
		startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
	)
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		draggingWindow = false
	end
end)

local slidingSmooth = false

local function setSmoothFromX(x)
	local absX = bar.AbsolutePosition.X
	local width = math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
	local t = math.clamp((x - absX) / width, 0, 1)
	smoothness = t
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(t, 0, 1, 0)
	handle.Position = UDim2.new(t, 0, 0.5, 0)
end

bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		slidingSmooth = true
		setSmoothFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not slidingSmooth then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		setSmoothFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		slidingSmooth = false
	end
end)

local isOn = false
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function getNearestRoot()
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		return nil
	end
	local origin = humanoidRootPart.Position
	local nearest = nil
	local shortest = MAX_RANGE

	for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if other ~= player then
			local char = other.Character
			if char then
				local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and root then
					local dist = (origin - root.Position).Magnitude
					if dist < shortest then
						shortest = dist
						nearest = root
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest
end

local function setToggleVisual(on)
	if on then
		TweenService:Create(knob, tweenInfo, {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 3),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 230, 120),
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(track, tweenInfo, {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 68, 45),
		}):Play()
		title.Text = "LOCK  •  ON"
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
	else
		TweenService:Create(knob, tweenInfo, {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75),
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(track, tweenInfo, {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48),
		}):Play()
		title.Text = "LOCK  •  OFF"
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 225)
	end
end

local function stopLock()
	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND_NAME)
	end)
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = savedAutoRotate
	end
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
end

local function startLock()
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
		if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoidRootPart.Parent then
			return
		end

		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

		if humanoid then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		end

		local target = getNearestRoot()
		if not target then
			return
		end

		local rootPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
		local targetPos = target.Position
		local flat = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, rootPos.Y, targetPos.Z)
		local dir = flat - rootPos
		if dir.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			return
		end
		dir = dir.Unit

		local desiredCam = rootPos - dir * CAMERA_DISTANCE + Vector3.new(0, CAMERA_HEIGHT, 0)
		local desiredCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(desiredCam, targetPos)

		local speed = 2 + (1 - smoothness) * 22
		local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-speed * dt)
		camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(desiredCFrame, alpha)

		local face = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, flat)
		humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, select(2, face:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()), 0)
	end)
end

local function toggleLock()
	isOn = not isOn
	setToggleVisual(isOn)
	if isOn then
		startLock()
	else
		stopLock()
	end
end

track.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleLock)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then
		toggleLock()
	end
end)

player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
	if isOn then
		stopLock()
		task.defer(function()
			if isOn then
				startLock()
			end
		end)
	end
end)

-- Audit: managed connections and reversible property overrides.
local running=true
local connections={}
local function connect(signal,fn)
    local connection=signal:Connect(function(...)
        if running then fn(...) end
    end)
    table.insert(connections,connection)
    return connection
end
local mutations={}
local humanoidStates={}
local writeOrder=0
local function setProperty(module,object,property,value)
    if not object then return end
    local ok=pcall(function()
        local properties=mutations[object]
        if not properties then properties={}; mutations[object]=properties end
        local record=properties[property]
        if not record then record={original=object[property],layers={}}; properties[property]=record end
        writeOrder+=1
        record.layers[module]={value=value,order=writeOrder}
        object[property]=value
    end)
    return ok
end
local function restoreModule(module)
    for object,properties in pairs(mutations) do
        for property,record in pairs(properties) do
            if record.layers[module] then
                record.layers[module]=nil
                local top
                for _,layer in pairs(record.layers) do if not top or layer.order>top.order then top=layer end end
                pcall(function() if top then object[property]=top.value else object[property]=record.original end end)
                if not top then properties[property]=nil end
            end
        end
        if not next(properties) then mutations[object]=nil end
    end
    if module=="NoFall" then
        for hum,states in pairs(humanoidStates) do
            for state,enabled in pairs(states) do pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(state,enabled) end) end
        end
        table.clear(humanoidStates)
    end
end
local function restoreAll()
    for object,properties in pairs(mutations) do
        for property,record in pairs(properties) do pcall(function() object[property]=record.original end) end
    end
    table.clear(mutations)
    restoreModule("NoFall")
end

-- Config profiles
local configDefaults=table.clone(S)
local configRefresh,configCallbacks,configRules={},{},{}
local function encodeConfig()
    local values={}
    for k,v in pairs(S) do if k~="AimOn" and k~="Panic" then
        if typeof(v)=="EnumItem" then values[k]={enum=tostring(v.EnumType):match("Enum%.(.+)"),name=v.Name}
        elseif typeof(v)=="Color3" then values[k]={r=v.R,g=v.G,b=v.B}
        else values[k]=v end
    end end
    return HS:JSONEncode({version=1,settings=values})
end
local function applyConfig(values)
    local nextValues=table.clone(configDefaults)
    local function finite(v) return type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)<math.huge end
    for k,v in pairs(values) do
        local default=configDefaults[k]
        if default~=nil and k~="AimOn" and k~="Panic" then
            if typeof(default)=="EnumItem" and type(v)=="table" then
                local allowed=(k=="AimKey" and (v.enum=="KeyCode" or v.enum=="UserInputType")) or (k=="PanicKey" and v.enum=="KeyCode")
                if allowed and type(v.name)=="string" then
                    local ok,item=pcall(function() return Enum[v.enum][v.name] end)
                    if ok and item and ((item.EnumType==Enum.KeyCode and item~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) or (k=="AimKey" and (item==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or item==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or item==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3))) then nextValues[k]=item end
                end
            elseif typeof(default)=="Color3" and type(v)=="table" then
                if finite(v.r) and finite(v.g) and finite(v.b) then nextValues[k]=Color3.new(math.clamp(v.r,0,1),math.clamp(v.g,0,1),math.clamp(v.b,0,1)) end
            elseif typeof(v)==typeof(default) then
                local rule=configRules[k]
                if type(v)=="number" then
                    if finite(v) then
                        if rule and rule.min then v=math.clamp(v,rule.min,rule.max); v=math.floor(v*10^rule.dec+.5)/10^rule.dec end
                        nextValues[k]=v
                    end
                elseif not rule or not rule.options or table.find(rule.options,v) then nextValues[k]=v end
            end
        end
    end
    nextValues.AimKeyMouse=nextValues.AimKey.EnumType==Enum.UserInputType
    nextValues.AimOn=false; nextValues.Panic=false
    for key in pairs(unsupported) do nextValues[key]=false end
    local changed={}
    for k,v in pairs(nextValues) do changed[k]=S[k]~=v; S[k]=v end
    for k,v in pairs(nextValues) do if changed[k] and v==false then restoreModule(k) end end
    particlesApplied=false
    for k,fn in pairs(configCallbacks) do if changed[k] then pcall(fn,S[k]) end end
    
for _,fn in ipairs(configRefresh) do pcall(fn) end
end

-- Auto Execute prefs (additive)
local AUTOEXEC_PATH = "CombatHubConfigs/_autoexec.json"
local autoExecEnabled = false
local autoExecProfile = "default"

local function loadAutoExecPrefs()
	if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return end
	pcall(function()
		if type(isfolder) == "function" and not isfolder("CombatHubConfigs") then return end
		if type(isfile) == "function" and not isfile(AUTOEXEC_PATH) then return end
		local data = HS:JSONDecode(readfile(AUTOEXEC_PATH))
		if type(data) == "table" then
			if type(data.enabled) == "boolean" then autoExecEnabled = data.enabled end
			if type(data.profile) == "string"
				and #data.profile > 0
				and #data.profile <= 48
				and data.profile:match("^[%w_-]+$") then
				autoExecProfile = data.profile
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function saveAutoExecPrefs()
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false, "File storage unavailable" end
	if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" then
		if not isfolder("CombatHubConfigs") then makefolder("CombatHubConfigs") end
	end
	writefile(AUTOEXEC_PATH, HS:JSONEncode({
		enabled = autoExecEnabled,
		profile = autoExecProfile,
	}))
	return true
end

local function runAutoExec()
	if not autoExecEnabled then return end
	if type(readfile) ~= "function" then
		warn("[combat hub] auto-exec skipped: no readfile")
		return
	end
	local name = tostring(autoExecProfile or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
	if name == "" or not name:match("^[%w_-]+$") then
		warn("[combat hub] auto-exec skipped: bad profile name")
		return
	end
	local path = "CombatHubConfigs/" .. name .. ".json"
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local text = readfile(path)
		local data = HS:JSONDecode(text)
		assert(type(data) == "table" and data.version == 1 and type(data.settings) == "table", "invalid profile")
		applyConfig(data.settings)
		HK = false
		CT = nil
	end)
	if ok then
		print("[combat hub] auto-exec loaded: " .. name)
	else
		warn("[combat hub] auto-exec failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

local function isGrenadeTool(tool)
	if not tool then return false end
	local n=tool.Name:lower()
	return n:find("grenade",1,true) or n:find("nade",1,true) or n:find("throw",1,true) or n:find("molotov",1,true) or n:find("flash",1,true) or n:find("smoke",1,true) or n:find("frag",1,true) or n:find("semtex",1,true) or n:find("beanbag",1,true)
end

local function updateGrenadeTrajectory()
	if not S.GrenadeTraj or S.Panic or not running then hideGrenTraj() return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then hideGrenTraj() return end
	local char = LP.Character
	local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if not S.GrenTrajAlways and not isGrenadeTool(tool) then hideGrenTraj() return end

	local origin = cam.CFrame.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector*2
	local vel = cam.CFrame.LookVector * (S.GrenSpeed or 100) + Vector3.new(0, S.GrenUp or 20, 0)
	local g = Vector3.new(0, -(S.GrenGravity or 196.2), 0)
	local dt = S.GrenTrajTime or 0.05
	local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(S.GrenTrajSteps or 40), 8, 80)
	local points = {origin}
	local pos, v = origin, vel
	local bounces = 0
	local maxB = S.GrenMaxBounces or 2
	local landPos = nil
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ex = {cam}
	if char then table.insert(ex, char) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ex
	params.IgnoreWater = false

	for i=1,steps do
		local nextV = v + g*dt
		local nextPos = pos + v*dt + g*(0.5*dt*dt)
		local dir = nextPos - pos
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(pos, dir, params)
		if hit then
			table.insert(points, hit.Position)
			landPos = hit.Position
			if S.GrenBounce and bounces < maxB then
				local n = hit.Normal
				v = nextV - 2*nextV:Dot(n)*n
				v = v * 0.55
				pos = hit.Position + n*0.05
				bounces += 1
				landPos = nil -- keep going
			else
				break
			end
		else
			pos = nextPos
			v = nextV
			table.insert(points, pos)
		end
	end
	if not landPos and #points > 0 then landPos = points[#points] end

	local baseThick = math.max(S.GrenThickness or 3, 2)
	local colA = S.GrenColor or Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 140)
	local colB = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
	local drawn = 0
	local nseg = #points - 1

	for i=1,nseg do
		local a,b = points[i], points[i+1]
		local pa, oa = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(a)
		local pb, ob = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(b)
		local line = grenLines[i]
		if line and oa and ob and pa.Z > 0 and pb.Z > 0 then
			local t = nseg > 1 and ((i-1)/(nseg-1)) or 0
			-- gradient: start color -> red toward impact
			local r = colA.R + (colB.R - colA.R) * t
			local gch = colA.G + (colB.G - colA.G) * t
			local bl = colA.B + (colB.B - colA.B) * t
			line.From = Vector2.new(pa.X, pa.Y)
			line.To = Vector2.new(pb.X, pb.Y)
			line.Thickness = baseThick + (1 - t) * 2 -- thicker near start
			line.Color = Color3.new(r, gch, bl)
			line.Transparency = 0.05 + t * 0.15
			line.Visible = true
			drawn = i
		elseif line then
			line.Visible = false
		end
	end
	for i=drawn+1,#grenLines do
		if grenLines[i] then grenLines[i].Visible=false end
	end

	-- dots along path for readability
	local dotCount = 0
	local stepDot = math.max(1, math.floor(#points / 12))
	for i=1,#points,stepDot do
		dotCount += 1
		local c = grenDots[dotCount]
		if not c then break end
		local p, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(points[i])
		if on and p.Z > 0 then
			local t = #points > 1 and ((i-1)/(#points-1)) or 0
			c.Position = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y)
			c.Radius = 3 + (1-t)*2
			c.Color = Color3.new(
				colA.R + (colB.R-colA.R)*t,
				colA.G + (colB.G-colA.G)*t,
				colA.B + (colB.B-colA.B)*t
			)
			c.Filled = true
			c.Visible = true
			c.Transparency = 0.1
		else
			c.Visible = false
		end
	end
	for i=dotCount+1,#grenDots do
		if grenDots[i] then grenDots[i].Visible=false end
	end

	-- impact marker
	if landPos and grenImpact then
		local ip, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(landPos)
		if on and ip.Z > 0 then
			local pulse = 10 + math.sin(os.clock()*8)*3
			grenImpact.Position = Vector2.new(ip.X, ip.Y)
			grenImpact.Radius = pulse
			grenImpact.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
			grenImpact.Thickness = 3
			grenImpact.Visible = true
			grenImpact.Transparency = 0.05
			local s = 9
			if grenImpactX1 then
				grenImpactX1.From = Vector2.new(ip.X - s, ip.Y - s)
				grenImpactX1.To = Vector2.new(ip.X + s, ip.Y + s)
				grenImpactX1.Visible = true
				grenImpactX1.Thickness = 3
			end
			if grenImpactX2 then
				grenImpactX2.From = Vector2.new(ip.X + s, ip.Y - s)
				grenImpactX2.To = Vector2.new(ip.X - s, ip.Y + s)
				grenImpactX2.Visible = true
				grenImpactX2.Thickness = 3
			end
		else
			grenImpact.Visible = false
			if grenImpactX1 then grenImpactX1.Visible=false end
			if grenImpactX2 then grenImpactX2.Visible=false end
		end
	elseif grenImpact then
		grenImpact.Visible = false
		if grenImpactX1 then grenImpactX1.Visible=false end
		if grenImpactX2 then grenImpactX2.Visible=false end
	end
end

local function solveThrowDirection(fromPos, targetPos, speed, gravity, upBoost)
	-- Ballistic aim: find look direction so projectile with speed+upBoost lands near target
	local g = gravity or 196.2
	local v0 = speed or 100
	local to = targetPos - fromPos
	local distXZ = Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z).Magnitude
	if distXZ < 0.5 then
		return (targetPos - fromPos).Unit
	end
	local y = to.Y
	-- quadratic for angle: use flat speed approximation with extra up
	-- try multiple pitch angles, pick best landing error
	local bestDir, bestErr = nil, math.huge
	local flat = Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z).Unit
	for deg = 5, 70, 0.75 do
		local pitch = math.rad(deg)
		local dir = (flat * math.cos(pitch) + Vector3.yAxis * math.sin(pitch)).Unit
		local vel = dir * v0 + Vector3.new(0, upBoost or 0, 0)
		local pos = fromPos
		local v = vel
		local dt = 0.05
		local err = math.huge
		for _=1,80 do
			v = v + Vector3.new(0, -g, 0) * dt
			local nextPos = pos + v * dt
			-- hit ground-ish near target height band
			if (nextPos - targetPos).Magnitude < err then
				err = (nextPos - targetPos).Magnitude
			end
			-- stop if passed target in XZ and going down
			local xz = Vector3.new(nextPos.X - fromPos.X, 0, nextPos.Z - fromPos.Z).Magnitude
			if xz > distXZ + 5 and v.Y < 0 then break end
			if nextPos.Y < targetPos.Y - 40 and v.Y < 0 then break end
			pos = nextPos
		end
		if err < bestErr then
			bestErr = err
			bestDir = dir
		end
	end
	return bestDir, bestErr
end

local function perfectThrowActive()
	if not S.PerfectThrow or S.Panic or not running then return false end
	local char = LP.Character
	local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	local holdingNade = isGrenadeTool(tool)
	if S.PerfectThrowAuto and holdingNade then return true end
	if not holdingNade and not S.GrenTrajAlways then return false end
	local key = S.PerfectThrowKey
	if typeof(key)=="EnumItem" then
		if key.EnumType==Enum.UserInputType then
			return UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(key)
		elseif key.EnumType==Enum.KeyCode then
			return UIS:IsKeyDown(key)
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function getNearestEnemyRoot()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return nil end
	local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
	local me = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if me then origin = me.Position end
	local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if alive(p) and p.Character then
			local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local d = (root.Position - origin).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist and d <= (S.MaxDist or 2000) then
					bestDist = d
					best = root
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestDist
end

local function updatePerfectThrow(dt)
	if not perfectThrowActive() then return end
	if bindingCapture or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() or pointerOverMenu() then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end
	-- always prefer nearest enemy for grenade lead
	local target = getNearestEnemyRoot()
	if not target then return end
	local lead = S.PerfectThrowLead or 0.15
	local aimPos = target.Position + Vector3.new(0, S.PerfectThrowHeight or 2, 0)
	local vel = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if vel and vel.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		aimPos = aimPos + vel * lead
	end
	local from = cam.CFrame.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5
	local dir = solveThrowDirection(from, aimPos, S.GrenSpeed or 100, S.GrenGravity or 196.2, S.GrenUp or 20)
	if not dir then return end
	local smooth = math.clamp(S.PerfectThrowSmooth or 0.35, 0.05, 1)
	local alpha = 1 - (1 - smooth) ^ (math.clamp(dt or 1/60, 0, 0.1) * 60)
	local want = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.Position + dir)
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(want, alpha)
end

	if not row or not name then return end

end

local function slider(parent,name,key,min,max,dec)
    if key=="RCSAfter" then name=name.." (not implemented)" end
	parent=settingsParent(parent,key)
	configRules[key]={min=min,max=max,dec=dec}
	local r=Instance.new("Frame",parent); r.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40); r.BackgroundTransparency=1; r.LayoutOrder=nord(parent)
	local lab=Instance.new("TextLabel",r); lab.Size=UDim2.new(0.7,0,0,14); lab.BackgroundTransparency=1; lab.Text=name; lab.TextColor3=T.txt; lab.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; lab.TextSize=12; lab.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local function fmt(v) if dec>0 then return string.format("%."..dec.."f",v) end return tostring(math.floor(v+.5)) end
	local val=Instance.new("TextLabel",r); val.Size=UDim2.new(0.3,0,0,14); val.Position=UDim2.new(0.7,0,0,0); val.BackgroundTransparency=1; val.Text=fmt(S[key]); val.TextColor3=T.acc; val.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; val.TextSize=11; val.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	local bar=Instance.new("Frame",r); bar.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,7); bar.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,22); bar.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,40,52); bar.BorderSizePixel=0; corner(bar,4)
	local fill=Instance.new("Frame",bar); local pct=(S[key]-min)/(max-min); fill.Size=UDim2.new(pct,0,1,0); fill.BackgroundColor3=T.acc; fill.BorderSizePixel=0; corner(fill,4)
	table.insert(configRefresh,function() fill.Size=UDim2.new(math.clamp((S[key]-min)/(max-min),0,1),0,1,0); val.Text=fmt(S[key]) end)
	local hold=false
	local function upd(x)
        if key=="RCSAfter" then return end
		local rel=math.clamp((x-bar.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X,1),0,1)
		local v=min+(max-min)*rel; if dec==0 then v=math.floor(v+.5) else v=math.floor(v*10^dec+.5)/10^dec end
		S[key]=v; fill.Size=UDim2.new(rel,0,1,0); val.Text=fmt(v)
	end
	connect(bar.InputBegan,function(i) if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then hold=true; upd(i.Position.X) end end)
	connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(i) if hold and i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(i.Position.X) end end)
	connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(i) if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then hold=false end end)
	bindTip(r, name)
end

local function keybind(parent,name,setFn,defaultText,configKey)
	parent=settingsParent(parent,configKey)
	local r=Instance.new("Frame",parent); r.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,28); r.BackgroundTransparency=1; r.LayoutOrder=nord(parent)
	local lab=Instance.new("TextLabel",r); lab.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,0); lab.BackgroundTransparency=1; lab.Text=name; lab.TextColor3=T.txt; lab.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; lab.TextSize=12; lab.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local b=Instance.new("TextButton",r); b.Size=UDim2.new(0,120,0,24); b.Position=UDim2.new(1,-120,0.5,-12); b.BackgroundColor3=T.p2; b.Text=defaultText; b.TextColor3=T.acc; b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; b.TextSize=11; corner(b,6)
	local listen=false
	if configKey then table.insert(configRefresh,function() listen=false; bindingCapture=false; b.Text=S[configKey].Name end) end
	connect(b.MouseButton1Click,function()
        if cancelCapture then cancelCapture() end
        listen=true; bindingCapture=true; b.Text="..."
        cancelCapture=function() listen=false; bindingCapture=false; b.Text=configKey and S[configKey].Name or defaultText end
    end)
	connect(UIS.InputBegan,function(i)
		if not listen then return end
        if configKey=="PanicKey" and i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        if i.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then listen=false; b.Text=configKey and S[configKey].Name or defaultText; task.defer(function() bindingCapture=false end); return end
		if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then listen=false; b.Text=i.KeyCode.Name; setFn(i.KeyCode,false); task.defer(function() bindingCapture=false end)
		elseif i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then listen=false; b.Text=i.UserInputType.Name; setFn(i.UserInputType,true); task.defer(function() bindingCapture=false end) end
	end)
	bindTip(r, name)
end

local function sendChatMessage(message)
    if chatBusy or not running or S.Panic then return end
    chatBusy=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            local textChat=game:GetService("TextChatService")
            local channels=textChat:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
            local channel=channels and channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then channel:SendAsync(tostring(message)); return end
            local events=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
            local remote=events and events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if remote then remote:FireServer(tostring(message),"All") else error("No supported chat channel") end
        end)
        chatBusy=false
        if not ok then warn("[combat hub] chat: "..tostring(err)) end
    end)
end

-- Auto reload best-effort
local lastReload = 0
local function tryAutoReload()
	if not S.AutoReload or S.Panic then return end
	if tick() - lastReload < 0.4 then return end
	local char = LP.Character
	local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if not tool then return end
	local need = false
	for _, v in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("IntValue") or v:IsA("NumberValue") then
			local n = v.Name:lower()
			if (n:find("ammo",1,true) or n:find("clip",1,true) or n:find("mag",1,true)) and v.Value <= 0 then
				need = true
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if need then
		lastReload = tick()
		pcall(function()
			if VIM then
				VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, S.AutoReloadKey or Enum.KeyCode.R, false, game)
				task.delay(0.05, function()
					pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, S.AutoReloadKey or Enum.KeyCode.R, false, game) end)
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- Grenade auto-calibrate: sample a real thrown projectile and fit gravity/speed
local calibrating = false
local calibConn = nil
local calibSamples = {}
local calibStart = 0

local function setCalibText(t, ok)
	local lab = rawget(_G, "CombatHubCalibLabel")
	if lab then
		lab.Text = t
		lab.TextColor3 = ok==true and T.ok or (ok==false and T.bad or T.dim)
	end
end

local function finishCalibrate(gravity, speed, upBoost)
	calibrating = false
	S.GrenAutoCalibrate = false
	if calibConn then pcall(function() calibConn:Disconnect() end) calibConn=nil end
	if gravity then S.GrenGravity = math.clamp(gravity, 40, 400) end
	if speed then S.GrenSpeed = math.clamp(speed, 30, 250) end
	if upBoost then S.GrenUp = math.clamp(upBoost, 0, 100) end
	-- tune related perfect-throw helpers for current values
	S.GrenTrajSteps = math.clamp(math.floor((S.GrenSpeed or 100) / 2), 24, 64)
	S.PerfectThrowLead = math.clamp((S.GrenSpeed or 100) / 700, 0.08, 0.35)
	for _,fn in ipairs(configRefresh) do pcall(fn) end
	setCalibText(string.format("Calibrated: g=%.1f speed=%.1f up=%.1f (applied to both modules)", S.GrenGravity, S.GrenSpeed, S.GrenUp), true)
	print(string.format("[combat hub] grenade calib g=%.2f speed=%.2f up=%.2f", S.GrenGravity, S.GrenSpeed, S.GrenUp))
end

local function estimateFromSamples(samples)
	if #samples < 4 then return nil end
	-- samples: {t, pos}
	local t0 = samples[1].t
	local p0 = samples[1].pos
	-- initial velocity from early samples
	local early = samples[math.min(3, #samples)]
	local dt1 = early.t - t0
	if dt1 <= 1e-3 then return nil end
	local v0 = (early.pos - p0) / dt1
	local speed = Vector3.new(v0.X, 0, v0.Z).Magnitude
	local up = math.max(0, v0.Y)
	-- gravity from vertical motion: y = y0 + v0y*t - 0.5*g*t^2
	local gSum, gN = 0, 0
	for i=3,#samples do
		local t = samples[i].t - t0
		if t > 0.05 then
			local y = samples[i].pos.Y - p0.Y
			-- y = v0y*t - 0.5*g*t^2  =>  g = 2*(v0y*t - y)/t^2
			local g = 2 * (v0.Y * t - y) / (t * t)
			if g > 20 and g < 500 then
				gSum += g
				gN += 1
			end
		end
	end
	if gN < 1 then return nil end
	return gSum / gN, speed, up
end

function startGrenadeCalibrate()
	if calibrating then
		setCalibText("Already calibrating — throw the grenade now", false)
		return
	end
	calibrating = true
	calibSamples = {}
	calibStart = tick()
	setCalibText("Calibrating… equip grenade and THROW once (4s window)", nil)
	local watched = {}
	if calibConn then pcall(function() calibConn:Disconnect() end) end
	calibConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
		if not calibrating then return end
		if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
		local n = obj.Name:lower()
		local look = n:find("grenade",1,true) or n:find("nade",1,true) or n:find("projectile",1,true)
			or n:find("throw",1,true) or n:find("frag",1,true) or n:find("molotov",1,true)
			or n:find("flash",1,true) or n:find("smoke",1,true) or n:find("ball",1,true)
		-- also accept unanchored parts spawned near camera with velocity
		task.defer(function()
			if not calibrating or not obj.Parent then return end
			local ok,vel = pcall(function() return obj.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
			if not ok or not vel then return end
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not cam then return end
			local near = (obj.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 25
			local moving = vel.Magnitude > 20
			if (look or (near and moving and not obj.Anchored)) and not watched[obj] then
				watched[obj] = true
				setCalibText("Tracking projectile…", nil)
				local samples = {}
				local start = tick()
				local conn
				conn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if not obj.Parent or tick()-start > 2.5 then
						conn:Disconnect()
						local g,sp,up = estimateFromSamples(samples)
						if g then
							finishCalibrate(g, sp, up)
						else
							setCalibText("Track failed — try a longer open throw", false)
							calibrating = false
						end
						return
					end
					local ok2,pos = pcall(function() return obj.Position end)
					if ok2 then table.insert(samples, {t=tick(), pos=pos}) end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
	-- timeout
	task.delay(5, function()
		if calibrating then
			calibrating = false
			if calibConn then pcall(function() calibConn:Disconnect() end) calibConn=nil end
			setCalibText("Timed out — press again and throw quickly", false)
		end
	end)
end


-- Auto jiggle peek (fixed)
local jiggleOn = false
local jigglePhase = 0
local jiggleOrigin = nil
local function jiggleActive()
	if not S.JigglePeek or S.Panic or not running then return false end
	if bindingCapture or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() or pointerOverMenu() then return false end
	if S.JiggleADS and not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then return false end
	if not S.JiggleShoot and UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then return false end
	local key = S.JiggleKey
	if S.JiggleMode == "Toggle" then return jiggleOn end
	if typeof(key)=="EnumItem" then
		if key.EnumType==Enum.KeyCode then return UIS:IsKeyDown(key) end
		if key.EnumType==Enum.UserInputType then return UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(key) end
	end
	return UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt)
end
local function updateJigglePeek(dt)
	local char = LP.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hum or not hrp then jiggleOrigin=nil return end
	if not jiggleActive() then
		jiggleOrigin = nil
		return
	end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end
	dt = math.clamp(dt or 1/60, 0, 0.1)
	if not jiggleOrigin then
		jiggleOrigin = hrp.Position
		jigglePhase = 0
	end
	jigglePhase = jigglePhase + (S.JiggleSpeed or 12) * dt
	local side = math.sin(jigglePhase * math.pi * 2) -- full left-right cycle
	local right = Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.RightVector.Z)
	if right.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return end
	right = right.Unit
	local dist = S.JiggleDist or 2.5
	-- target offset from origin along camera right
	local target = jiggleOrigin + right * (side * dist)
	local to = target - hrp.Position
	local flat = Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z)
	local speed = math.max(hum.WalkSpeed, 18) * 1.35
	if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local dir = flat.Unit
		hum:Move(dir, false)
		local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * speed, v.Y, dir.Z * speed)
	else
		hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
	end
	-- slowly recenter origin so you can walk while jiggling
	jiggleOrigin = jiggleOrigin:Lerp(Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, jiggleOrigin.Y, hrp.Position.Z), dt * 2)
end


-- Auto inspect / emote on kill
local lastInspect, lastEmote = 0, 0
local lastKills = nil
local healthCache = {}
local recentCombat = {} -- player -> last time we aimed/shot near them
local function pressKey(key, dur)
	if typeof(key)~="EnumItem" or key.EnumType~=Enum.KeyCode then return end
	pcall(function()
		if VIM then
			VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, key, false, game)
			task.delay(dur or 0.08, function()
				pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, key, false, game) end)
			end)
		end
	end)
end
local function doInspect()
	if not S.AutoInspect or S.Panic then return end
	local now = tick()
	if now - lastInspect < 0.2 then return end
	lastInspect = now
	local delay = S.InspectDelay or 0.35
	task.delay(delay, function()
		if S.Panic or not S.AutoInspect then return end
		if UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then return end
		pressKey(S.InspectKey or Enum.KeyCode.F, 0.1)
		local char = LP.Character
		local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if tool then
			pcall(function()
				for _,v in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
					if v:IsA("BindableEvent") and v.Name:lower():find("inspect",1,true) then
						v:Fire(); break
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end
local function doEmote()
	if not S.AutoEmote or S.Panic then return end
	local now = tick()
	if now - lastEmote < 0.2 then return end
	lastEmote = now
	local delay = S.EmoteDelay or 0.6
	task.delay(delay, function()
		if S.Panic or not S.AutoEmote then return end
		if UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then return end
		pressKey(S.EmoteKey or Enum.KeyCode.Period, 0.1)
		pcall(function()
			local char = LP.Character
			local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
			if animate then
				local emote = animate:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote") or animate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BindableFunction")
				if emote and emote:IsA("BindableFunction") then
					pcall(function() emote:Invoke("wave") end)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)
end
local function onGotKill()
	if S.InspectOnKill then doInspect() end
	if S.EmoteOnKill then doEmote() end
end
local function markCombat(player)
	if player and player ~= LP then recentCombat[player] = tick() end
end
local function updateInspectEmote()
	if S.Panic or not running then return end
	-- track combat via current aim target
	if CT and CT.Parent then
		local pl = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(CT.Parent)
		if pl then markCombat(pl) end
	end
	if UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
			for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if p ~= LP and p.Character then
					local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if root and (root.Position - origin).Magnitude < 120 then
						markCombat(p)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- leaderstats kills
	pcall(function()
		local ls = LP:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local kills = ls and (ls:FindFirstChild("Kills") or ls:FindFirstChild("Kill") or ls:FindFirstChild("Wipes"))
		if kills and (kills:IsA("IntValue") or kills:IsA("NumberValue")) then
			if lastKills ~= nil and kills.Value > lastKills then
				onGotKill()
			end
			lastKills = kills.Value
		end
	end)
	-- health drop to 0 while recently in combat with them
	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= LP and p.Character then
			local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				local prev = healthCache[p]
				local hp = hum.Health
				if prev and prev > 0 and hp <= 0 then
					local t = recentCombat[p]
					if t and tick() - t < 8 then
						onGotKill()
					end
				end
				healthCache[p] = hp
			end
		else
			healthCache[p] = nil
		end
	end
end

	recentCombat[p] = nil
end)

local friendshipCache={}
local function alive(p)
    if not p or p==LP then return false end
    local char=p.Character
    local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return false end
    if S.IgnoreDowned and hum.Health<=5 then return false end

    if S.IgnoreFriends then
        local cached=friendshipCache[p.UserId]
        if cached==nil then
            friendshipCache[p.UserId]="pending"
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok,result=pcall(function() return LP:IsFriendsWith(p.UserId) end)
                if running and p.Parent then friendshipCache[p.UserId]=ok and result or false end

local function lineOfSight(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return false end
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false end
    local origin=camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction=part.Position-origin
    local character=part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or part.Parent
    if direction.Magnitude<0.001 then return true end
    local exclusions={camera}
    if LP.Character then table.insert(exclusions,LP.Character) end
    local params=RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater=true
    for _=1,12 do
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances=exclusions
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(origin,direction,params)
        if not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) then return true end
        local obstacle=hit.Instance
        if obstacle:IsA("BasePart") and obstacle.Transparency>=0.95 then
            table.insert(exclusions,obstacle)
        else return false end
    end
    return false
end
local function wallOk(part)
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera or not part or not part.Parent then return false end
    if S.VisibleOnly then
        local projected,onScreen=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen or projected.Z<=0 then return false end
    end
    if S.WallCheck or S.VisibleOnly or S.AutoWall then return lineOfSight(part) end
    return true
end

local randomAimParts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function aimPart(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local mine=LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if S.ForceHeadClose and root and mine and (root.Position-mine.Position).Magnitude<=S.CloseRange then
        return char:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
    end
    if S.HeadOnly then return char:FindFirstChild("Head") or root end
    if S.LockPart=="Torso" then return char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or root end
    if S.LockPart=="Random" then
        local cached=randomAimParts[char]
        if cached and cached.Parent==char then return cached end
        local candidates={}
        for _,name in ipairs({"Head","UpperTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"}) do
            local part=char:FindFirstChild(name); if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(candidates,part) end
        end
        if #candidates>0 then local part=candidates[math.random(1,#candidates)]; randomAimParts[char]=part; return part end
    end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
end
local function targetMetrics(part,camera,origin,root,fov)
    if not part or not part.Parent or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
    if root and (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>S.MaxDist then return nil end
    if not wallOk(part) then return nil end
    local point,onScreen=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    if not onScreen or point.Z<=0 then return nil end
    local cross=(Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)-origin).Magnitude
    if cross>fov then return nil end
    return cross
end
local function getTarget()
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then CT=nil; return nil end
    Cam=camera
    local origin=aimPosition()
    local root=LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local fov=S.FOV+(S.DynFOV and S.DynFOVAdd or 0)
    local current
    if CT and CT.Parent then
        local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(CT.Parent)
        if player and alive(player) then
            local part=aimPart(player.Character)
            if targetMetrics(part,camera,origin,root,fov) then current=part end
        end
    end
    if current and (S.StickyAim or os.clock()-lastSwitch<S.SwitchDelay) then CT=current; return current end
    local best,bestScore=nil,math.huge
    for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if alive(player) then
            local part=aimPart(player.Character)
            local cross=targetMetrics(part,camera,origin,root,fov)
            if cross then
                local score=cross
                if S.Priority=="Distance" then score=(part.Position-(root and root.Position or camera.CFrame.Position)).Magnitude
                elseif S.Priority=="LowestHP" then local hum=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); score=hum and hum.Health or math.huge end
                if score<bestScore then bestScore=score; best=part end
            end
        end
    end
    if best~=CT then lastSwitch=os.clock() end
    CT=best
    return best
end
local function aimOn()
    if S.Panic or not S.Aimbot or bindingCapture or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() or pointerOverMenu() then return false end
    if S.ADSOnly and not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then return false end
    if S.AimMode=="Toggle" then return S.AimOn end
    if S.AimKeyMouse then return UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(S.AimKey) end
    return UIS:IsKeyDown(S.AimKey)
end
local function moveTo(part,str,dt)
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera or not part or not part.Parent then return end
    local pos=part.Position+part.AssemblyLinearVelocity*S.Prediction
    if S.Humanize then
        local t=os.clock()
        pos+=Vector3.new(math.noise(t*3,0),math.noise(0,t*3),math.noise(t*3,t*3))*S.Jitter
    end
    local point,onScreen=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
    if not onScreen or point.Z<=0 then return end
    local origin=aimPosition()
    local distance=(Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)-origin).Magnitude
    local rate=math.clamp(str,0,1)
    if S.MagnetAim and distance<S.FOV*0.35 then rate=math.max(rate,S.MagnetStr) end
    local alpha=1-(1-rate)^(math.clamp(dt or 1/60,0,0.1)*60)
    if S.AimMethod=="Mouse" and type(mousemoverel)=="function" then
        mousemoverel((point.X-origin.X)*alpha,(point.Y-origin.Y)*alpha)
    else
        if (pos-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude>0.001 then
            camera.CFrame=camera.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position,pos),alpha)
        end
    end
end

	-- anti recoil (camera moves like mouse)
	local shooting = UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
	if S.AntiRecoil and not S.Panic and (not S.AROnlyShoot or shooting) and shooting then
		if not savedPitch then savedPitch=Cam.CFrame; shootStart=tick(); patternMul=1 end
		if S.Pattern then patternMul=math.min(S.PatternCap,patternMul+(S.PatternScale or 0.15)*dt*60) end
		local v = math.clamp((S.VStr or 2.4)*patternMul, 0, 20)
		local h = ((math.floor((tick()-(shootStart or tick()))*10)%2==0) and 1 or -1)*(S.HStr or 0.6)*patternMul
		local smooth = math.clamp(S.ARSmooth or 1, 0.2, 1)
		local mode = S.ARMode or "Camera"
		local skipAim = aimOn() or S.AimAssist
		if not skipAim then
			-- pixel deltas similar to mouse movement
			local dx = h * dt * 60 * smooth
			local dy = -v * dt * 60 * smooth
			if (mode=="Mouse" or mode=="Both") and type(mousemoverel)=="function" then
				mousemoverel(dx, dy)
			end
			if mode=="Camera" or mode=="Both" or type(mousemoverel)~="function" then
				-- convert mouse-like deltas into camera pitch/yaw (approx degrees)

				local pos = cf.Position
				-- yaw around world up, pitch around camera right

			end
		elseif S.LockPitch and savedPitch and not aimOn() then
			local look,pos,base=Cam.CFrame.LookVector,Cam.CFrame.Position,savedPitch.LookVector
			local flat=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude>0.001 then Cam.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos,pos+Vector3.new(flat.Unit.X,base.Y,flat.Unit.Z).Unit) end
		end

		if savedPitch and (not shooting) then

			if shootStart and tick()-shootStart > (S.ARReset or 0.2) then

local function projectedBounds(char,camera)
    local cf,size=char:GetBoundingBox()
    local minX,minY,maxX,maxY=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
    for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
        local point=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(x*size.X/2,y*size.Y/2,z*size.Z/2)))
        if point.Z<=0.1 then return nil end
        minX=math.min(minX,point.X); minY=math.min(minY,point.Y)
        maxX=math.max(maxX,point.X); maxY=math.max(maxY,point.Y)
    end end end
    local viewport=camera.ViewportSize
    if maxX<0 or maxY<0 or minX>viewport.X or minY>viewport.Y then return nil end
    return minX,minY,maxX,maxY
end

--==================================================

--==================================================

local function createSound(name, id, volume)

	if not root then
		return nil
	end

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = name
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	sound.Volume = volume
	sound.Looped = false
	sound.Parent = root

	return sound
end

--==================================================
-- ESPERAR A QUE CARGUE UN SONIDO
--==================================================

local function waitForSound(sound)

	if not sound then
		return false
	end

	if sound.IsLoaded then
		return true
	end

	local loaded = false

	local connection

	connection = sound.Loaded:Connect(function()
		loaded = true
	end)

	local startTime = os.clock()

	while not loaded and not sound.IsLoaded do

		if os.clock() - startTime >= 8 then
			break
		end

		task.wait()
	end

	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	return sound.IsLoaded
end

--==================================================
-- REPRODUCIR Y ESPERAR
--==================================================

local function playAndWait(sound)

	if not sound then
		return
	end

	if not waitForSound(sound) then
		warn("No se pudo cargar el sonido: " .. sound.SoundId)
		sound:Destroy()
		return
	end

	sound:Play()

	while sound.IsPlaying do
		task.wait()
	end
end

--==================================================
-- LOOP DEL PANDA
--==================================================

local function startPandaLoop()

	if not root then
		return
	end

	-- Eliminar loop anterior
	if pandaSound then
		pandaSound:Stop()
		pandaSound:Destroy()
		pandaSound = nil
	end

	pandaSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	pandaSound.Name = "PandaLoop"
	pandaSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. PANDA_SOUND_ID
	pandaSound.Volume = pandaVolume
	pandaSound.Looped = true
	pandaSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1
	pandaSound.Parent = root

	if waitForSound(pandaSound) then

		if pandaEnabled then
			pandaSound:Play()

			playButton.Text = "⏸  PAUSE"
			status.Text = "● REPRODUCIENDO"
			status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 125)
		end

	else

		warn("No se pudo cargar el loop del panda.")

		status.Text = "● ERROR DE AUDIO"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 90, 90)
	end
end

--==================================================
-- 😱 SECUENCIA DE APARICIÓN
--==================================================

local function playPandaArrival()

	if arrivalRunning then
		return
	end

	if not root then
		return
	end

	arrivalRunning = true

	status.Text = "● SUSTO 1"
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 90, 90)

	-- SUSTO 1
	local scare1 = createSound(
		"PandaScare1",
		SCARE_SOUND_1,
		1
	)

	playAndWait(scare1)

	if scare1 then
		scare1:Destroy()
	end

	-- Si el panda fue apagado mientras sonaba
	if not pandaEnabled or not root then
		arrivalRunning = false
		return
	end

	status.Text = "● SUSTO 2"
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 90, 90)

	-- SUSTO 2
	local scare2 = createSound(
		"PandaScare2",
		SCARE_SOUND_2,
		1
	)

	playAndWait(scare2)

	if scare2 then
		scare2:Destroy()
	end

	-- Comprobar otra vez
	if not pandaEnabled or not root then
		arrivalRunning = false
		return
	end

	-- Ahora comienza el loop
	status.Text = "● PANDA LOOP"
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 125)

	startPandaLoop()

	arrivalRunning = false
end

--==================================================
-- PLAY / PAUSA
--==================================================

playButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if not pandaSound then

		startPandaLoop()

		return
	end

	if pandaSound.IsPlaying then

		pandaSound:Pause()

		playButton.Text = "▶  PLAY"
		status.Text = "● PAUSADO"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 180, 80)

	else

		pandaSound:Resume()

		playButton.Text = "⏸  PAUSE"
		status.Text = "● REPRODUCIENDO"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 125)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- PANDA ON / OFF
--==================================================

pandaButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	pandaEnabled = not pandaEnabled

	if pandaEnabled then

		pandaButton.Text = "🐼  PANDA ON"

		if pandaGui then
			pandaGui.Enabled = true
		end

		if pandaSound then
			pandaSound:Resume()

			playButton.Text = "⏸  PAUSE"
			status.Text = "● REPRODUCIENDO"
			status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 125)
		else
			task.spawn(function()
				startPandaLoop()
			end)
		end

	else

		pandaButton.Text = "🐼  PANDA OFF"

		if pandaGui then
			pandaGui.Enabled = false
		end

		if pandaSound then
			pandaSound:Pause()
		end

		status.Text = "● PANDA OFF"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 165)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CREAR PANDA
--==================================================

local function createPanda(character)

	-- Cancelar estado anterior
	arrivalRunning = false

	-- Limpiar sonido anterior
	if pandaSound then
		pandaSound:Stop()
		pandaSound:Destroy()
		pandaSound = nil
	end

	-- Limpiar panda anterior
	if pandaGui then
		pandaGui:Destroy()
		pandaGui = nil
	end

	root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	-- Ocultar avatar localmente
	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do

		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1

		elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
			object.Transparency = 1
		end
	end

	-- Crear panda
	pandaGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

    local dragging = false
    
    SliderButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        dragging = true
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if dragging then
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local relativePos = mousePos.X - SliderBack.AbsolutePosition.X
            local percentage = math.clamp(relativePos / SliderBack.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local value = math.floor(min + (max - min) * percentage)
            
            SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
            Label.Text = text .. ": " .. value
            callback(value)
        end
    end)
    
    return Container
end
