-- FOV Circle for Aimbot (Single RGB circle)
local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVCircle.Thickness = 2
FOVCircle.NumSides = 100
FOVCircle.Radius = Config.AimbotFOV
FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
FOVCircle.Visible = false
FOVCircle.Filled = false
FOVCircle.Transparency = 1

-- RGB Animation values
local rgbHue = 0

-- Game Functions
local function getCharacter()
    return LocalPlayer.Character
end

local function getHumanoidRootPart()
    local char = getCharacter()
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getTargetPart(player)
    if not player.Character then return nil end
    
    if Config.AimbotTarget == "Head" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Body" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Legs+Body" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Body+Head" then
        local head = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local torso = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        return head or torso
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "All" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
end

local function isInFOV(targetPos)
    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
    
    local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPos)
    if not onScreen then return false end
    
    local screenPosition = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
    local distance = (screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude
    
    return distance <= Config.AimbotFOV
end

local function getNearestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local targetPart = getTargetPart(player)
            if targetPart then
                local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
                if onScreen and isInFOV(targetPart.Position) then
                    local screenPosition = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                    local distance = (screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude
                    if distance < shortestDistance then
                        shortestDistance = distance
                        nearestPlayer = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearestPlayer
end

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local nearestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not myRootPart then return nil end
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local theirRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if theirRootPart then
                local distance = (myRootPart.Position - theirRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < shortestDistance then
                    shortestDistance = distance
                    nearestPlayer = player
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearestPlayer
end

local function getNearestCar()
    local nearestCar = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not myRootPart then return nil end
    
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("VehicleSeat") or (obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat")) then
            local model = obj:IsA("Model") and obj or obj.Parent
            local primaryPart = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            
            if primaryPart then
                local distance = (myRootPart.Position - primaryPart.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < shortestDistance and distance < 100 then
                    shortestDistance = distance
                    nearestCar = model
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearestCar
end

local function getAllNearbyPlayers(radius)
    local nearbyPlayers = {}
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not myRootPart then return nearbyPlayers end
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local theirRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if theirRootPart then
                local distance = (myRootPart.Position - theirRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if distance <= radius then
                    table.insert(nearbyPlayers, player)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearbyPlayers
end

-- Feature Functions
local function flingPlayer(targetPlayer)
    local char = getCharacter()
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not char or not myRootPart then return end
    if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then return end
    
    local targetRootPart = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetRootPart then return end
    
    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, Config.FlingPower, 0)
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyVelocity.Parent = myRootPart
    
    myRootPart.CFrame = targetRootPart.CFrame
    
    wait(0.1)
    
    bodyVelocity:Destroy()
    myRootPart.CFrame = myRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
end

local function flingNearestPlayer()
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    if target then
        flingPlayer(target)
        print("🎯 Flinging: " .. target.Name)
    else
        print("❌ No nearby players found")
    end
end

local function flingAllNearby()
    local nearbyPlayers = getAllNearbyPlayers(Config.FlingAllRadius)
    
    if #nearbyPlayers == 0 then
        print("❌ No nearby players found")
        return
    end
    
    print("💥 Flinging " .. #nearbyPlayers .. " nearby players")
    
    for _, player in pairs(nearbyPlayers) do
        spawn(function()
            flingPlayer(player)
        end)
        wait(0.5)
    end
end

-- Aimbot (FIXED - Single RGB circle, only locks players in front)
local aimbotConnection = nil
local fovUpdateConnection = nil

local function startAimbot()
    Config.AimbotEnabled = true
    
    -- Separate connection for FOV circle updates with RGB animation
    fovUpdateConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
        local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
        
        -- Update circle position and radius
        FOVCircle.Position = screenCenter
        FOVCircle.Radius = Config.AimbotFOV
        FOVCircle.Visible = true
        
        -- RGB color animation
        rgbHue = rgbHue + 0.01
        if rgbHue >= 1 then
            rgbHue = 0
        end
        FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromHSV(rgbHue, 1, 1)
    end)
    
    -- Main aimbot logic
    aimbotConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Config.AimbotEnabled then return end
        
        -- Only target players within the FOV circle and in front
        local target = getNearestPlayerInFOV()
        if not target or not target.Character then return end
        
        local targetPart = getTargetPart(target)
        if not targetPart then return end
        
        -- Verify target is in front of camera (not behind)
        local cameraLookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local targetDirection = (targetPart.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
        local dotProduct = cameraLookVector:Dot(targetDirection)
        
        -- Only lock if target is in front (dot product > 0)
        if dotProduct <= 0 then return end
        
        -- Double check if target is still in FOV
        if not isInFOV(targetPart.Position) then return end
        
        -- Smoothly aim at target
        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
    end)
    
    print("🎯 Aimbot enabled (RGB circle, only targets players in FOV)")
end

local function stopAimbot()
    Config.AimbotEnabled = false
    FOVCircle.Visible = false
    
    if aimbotConnection then
        aimbotConnection:Disconnect()
        aimbotConnection = nil
    end
    
    if fovUpdateConnection then
        fovUpdateConnection:Disconnect()
        fovUpdateConnection = nil
    end
    
    print("❌ Aimbot disabled")
end

-- Fly
local flyConnection = nil
local flyBodyVelocity = nil
local flyBodyGyro = nil

local function startFly()
    local char = getCharacter()
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not char or not myRootPart then return end
    
    Config.FlyEnabled = true
    
    flyBodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    flyBodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    flyBodyVelocity.Parent = myRootPart
    
    flyBodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    flyBodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    flyBodyGyro.P = 9000
    flyBodyGyro.Parent = myRootPart
    
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Config.FlyEnabled then return end
        
        local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
        if not myRootPart then return end
        
        local moveDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        
        flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDirection * Config.FlySpeed
        flyBodyGyro.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
    end)
    
    print("✈️ Fly enabled")
end

local function stopFly()
    Config.FlyEnabled = false
    
    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end
    
    if flyBodyVelocity then
        flyBodyVelocity:Destroy()
        flyBodyVelocity = nil
    end
    
    if flyBodyGyro then
        flyBodyGyro:Destroy()
        flyBodyGyro = nil
    end
    
    print("❌ Fly disabled")
end

-- Car Throwing
local function throwCar()
    local nearestCar = getNearestCar()
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not nearestCar then
        print("❌ No nearby car found")
        return
    end
    
    if not myRootPart then return end
    
    print("🚗 Throwing car: " .. nearestCar.Name)
    
    for _, part in pairs(nearestCar:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Anchored = false
            
            local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bodyVelocity.Velocity = Camera.CFrame.LookVector * Config.ThrowPower + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
            bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bodyVelocity.Parent = part
            
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(bodyVelocity, 0.5)
        end
    end
end

-- Backshots Feature (Realistic back and forth motion)
local backshotsConnection = nil
local backshotsTarget = nil
local backshotsCurrentDistance = 0
local backshotsMovingForward = true

local function startBackshots()
    Config.BackshotsEnabled = true
    backshotsTarget = getNearestPlayer()
    backshotsCurrentDistance = Config.BackshotsDistance
    backshotsMovingForward = true
    
    if not backshotsTarget then
        print("❌ No player found for backshots")
        Config.BackshotsEnabled = false
        return
    end
    
    print("😈 Backshots activated on: " .. backshotsTarget.Name)
    
    backshotsConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Config.BackshotsEnabled then return end
        
        local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
        if not myRootPart then return end
        
        if not backshotsTarget or not backshotsTarget.Character then
            Config.BackshotsEnabled = false
            return
        end
        
        local targetRootPart = backshotsTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not targetRootPart then return end
        
        -- Animate back and forth movement
        if backshotsMovingForward then
            backshotsCurrentDistance = backshotsCurrentDistance - (Config.BackshotsSpeed * 0.1)
            if backshotsCurrentDistance <= 0.5 then
                backshotsMovingForward = false
            end
        else
            backshotsCurrentDistance = backshotsCurrentDistance + (Config.BackshotsSpeed * 0.1)
            if backshotsCurrentDistance >= Config.BackshotsDistance then
                backshotsMovingForward = true
            end
        end
        
        -- Position behind the target with animated distance
        local behindPosition = targetRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, backshotsCurrentDistance)
        
        -- Keep character facing the target's back
        local lookAtTarget = CFrame.new(behindPosition.Position, targetRootPart.Position)
        
        myRootPart.CFrame = lookAtTarget
        
        -- Lock camera to view from behind and slightly above
        local cameraOffset = targetRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, Config.BackshotsDistance + 2)
        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(cameraOffset.Position, targetRootPart.Position)
    end)
end

local function stopBackshots()
    Config.BackshotsEnabled = false
    backshotsTarget = nil
    backshotsCurrentDistance = 0
    backshotsMovingForward = true
    
    if backshotsConnection then
        backshotsConnection:Disconnect()
        backshotsConnection = nil
    end
    
    print("❌ Backshots disabled")
end

-- Create Tabs
local combatTab = createTab("Combat", "⚔️", 1)
local movementTab = createTab("Movement", "🏃", 2)
local trollTab = createTab("Troll", "😈", 3)

local currentTab = "Combat"

local function showTab(tabName)
    for _, child in pairs(ContentFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
    
    currentTab = tabName
    
    if tabName == "Combat" then
        combatTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 43, 226)
        combatTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        movementTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        movementTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        trollTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        trollTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        
        createToggleWithKeybind("Aimbot", "🎯", "Aimbot", function(enabled)
            if enabled then
                startAimbot()
            else
                stopAimbot()
            end
        end)
        
        createDropdown("Aimbot Target", {"Head", "Body", "Legs+Body", "Body+Head", "All"}, "Head", function(value)
            Config.AimbotTarget = value
            print("🎯 Aimbot target: " .. value)
        end)
        
        createSlider("Aimbot FOV", 50, 500, Config.AimbotFOV, function(value)
            Config.AimbotFOV = value
        end)
        
    elseif tabName == "Movement" then
        combatTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        combatTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        movementTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 43, 226)
        movementTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        trollTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        trollTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        
        createToggleWithKeybind("Fly Mode", "✈️", "Fly", function(enabled)
            if enabled then
                startFly()
            else
                stopFly()
            end
        end)
        
        createSlider("Fly Speed", 50, 300, Config.FlySpeed, function(value)
            Config.FlySpeed = value
        end)
        
    elseif tabName == "Troll" then
        combatTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        combatTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        movementTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        movementTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        trollTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 43, 226)
        trollTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        
        createToggleWithKeybind("Backshots Mode", "😈", "Backshots", function(enabled)
            if enabled then
                startBackshots()
            else
                stopBackshots()
            end
        end)
        
        createSlider("Backshots Distance", 2, 8, Config.BackshotsDistance, function(value)
            Config.BackshotsDistance = value
        end)
        
        createSlider("Backshots Speed", 0.5, 5, Config.BackshotsSpeed, function(value)
            Config.BackshotsSpeed = value
        end)
        
        createButtonWithKeybind("Fling Nearest", "💥", "FlingNearest", flingNearestPlayer)
        
        createButtonWithKeybind("Fling All Nearby", "💫", "FlingAll", flingAllNearby)
        
        createButtonWithKeybind("Throw Car", "🚗", "ThrowCar", throwCar)
        
        createSlider("Fling Power", 100, 1000, Config.FlingPower, function(value)
            Config.FlingPower = value
        end)
    end
end

combatTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showTab("Combat") end)
movementTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showTab("Movement") end)
trollTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showTab("Troll") end)

-- Show Combat tab by default
showTab("Combat")

-- Keyboard Shortcuts (using customizable keybinds)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed or currentKeybindChanging then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    
    -- Check each keybind dynamically
    for action, keyCode in pairs(Keybinds) do
        if input.KeyCode == keyCode then
            if action == "FlingNearest" then
                flingNearestPlayer()
            elseif action == "Aimbot" then
                if Config.AimbotEnabled then
                    stopAimbot()
                else
                    startAimbot()
                end
            elseif action == "Fly" then
                if Config.FlyEnabled then
                    stopFly()
                else
                    startFly()
                end
            elseif action == "ThrowCar" then
                throwCar()
            elseif action == "FlingAll" then
                flingAllNearby()
            elseif action == "Backshots" then
                if Config.BackshotsEnabled then
                    stopBackshots()
                else
                    startBackshots()
                end
            end
            break
        end
    end
end)

-- Cleanup
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    stopFly()
    stopAimbot()
    stopBackshots()
end)

    uiCorner.Parent = frame

    local uiGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    uiGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30))
    })
    uiGradient.Rotation = 45
    uiGradient.Parent = frame

    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    uiStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 110)
    uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    uiStroke.Parent = frame

    return frame
end

-- Core Functionality Definitions
local function tiltCharacter45()
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local humanoidRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRoot then return end

    local originalCF = humanoidRoot.CFrame
    local tiltCF = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
    humanoidRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(originalCF.Position) * tiltCF * originalCF.Rotation
end

local isSpinning = false
local function rotateCamera(deg)
    local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local newCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(deg), 0) * Camera.CFrame
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position) * newCFrame.Rotation
end

local function runSpinSequence(duration)
    if isSpinning then return end
    isSpinning = true
    local startTime = tick()

    task.spawn(function()
        while tick() - startTime < duration do
            rotateCamera(-180)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            rotateCamera(180)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        isSpinning = false
    end)
end

local CLR_DIVIDER         = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)

local BRAND_TAG           = "By: DoodScriptBoy"
local BRAND_DISCORD       = "https://discord.gg/5xUYcteRC"

local espOn        = false
local aimOn        = false
local target       = nil
local lastSwitch   = 0
local lastEspTick  = 0
local lastShot     = 0
local highlights   = {}
local nameTags     = {}
local wmGui, wmFrame, wmStatus
local hopGui, hopOpen
local killSoundInst
local conns = {}

local function keep(c)
    conns[#conns + 1] = c
    return c
end

local function alive(plr)
    local c = plr.Character
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and c.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function parentGui()
    return (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
end

local function panel(props)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.BackgroundColor3        = props.bg or CLR_BG
    f.BackgroundTransparency  = props.bgT or 0.15
    f.BorderSizePixel         = 0
    f.Size                    = props.size
    f.Position                = props.pos
    f.AnchorPoint             = props.anchor or Vector2.new(0, 0)
    f.Parent                  = props.parent
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, props.radius or 10)
    c.Parent = f
    if props.stroke ~= false then
        local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        s.Color = props.strokeClr or CLR_ACCENT
        s.Thickness = props.strokeW or 1.3
        s.Transparency = props.strokeT or 0.35
        s.Parent = f
    end
    return f
end

local function label(props)
    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.Font = props.font or Enum.Font.Gotham
    l.TextSize = props.size or 13
    l.TextColor3 = props.color or CLR_TEXT
    l.TextXAlignment = props.x or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    l.Text = props.text or ""
    l.Position = props.pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    l.Size = props.dim or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    l.TextStrokeTransparency = props.stroke == false and 1 or 0.6
    l.Parent = props.parent
    return l
end

local function buildWatermark()
    wmGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    wmGui.Name = "nt_watermark"
    wmGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    wmGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    wmGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    wmGui.DisplayOrder = 999
    wmGui.Parent = parentGui()

    wmFrame = panel({
        parent = wmGui,
        size = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 0),
        pos = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, -14),
        anchor = Vector2.new(1, 1),
        radius = 10,
        bgT = 0.2,
        strokeClr = CLR_ACCENT,
        strokeT = 0.5,
    })
    wmFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    pad.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 10)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
    pad.PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, 12)
    pad.PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, 12)
    pad.Parent = wmFrame

    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
    list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
    list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    list.Parent = wmFrame

    local brand = label({
        parent = wmFrame, font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, size = 13,
        color = CLR_ACCENT, text = "NEON TEAM", x = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        dim = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
    })
    brand.LayoutOrder = 1

    wmStatus = {}
    local function row(order, key)
        local r = label({
            parent = wmFrame, font = Enum.Font.Gotham, size = 12,
            color = CLR_MUTED, text = key .. "   off", x = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            dim = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15),
        })
        r.LayoutOrder = order
        wmStatus[key] = r
    end

    row(2, "esp")
    row(3, "aim")
    row(4, "smooth")

    local div = Instance.new("Frame")
    div.BackgroundColor3 = CLR_DIVIDER
    div.BorderSizePixel = 0
    div.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
    div.LayoutOrder = 5
    div.Parent = wmFrame

    local sig = label({
        parent = wmFrame, font = Enum.Font.Gotham, size = 11,
        color = CLR_MUTED, text = BRAND_TAG, x = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        dim = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
    })
    sig.LayoutOrder = 6

    local dis = label({
        parent = wmFrame, font = Enum.Font.Gotham, size = 11,
        color = CLR_MUTED, text = BRAND_DISCORD, x = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        dim = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
    })
    dis.LayoutOrder = 7
end

local function refreshStatus()
    if not wmStatus then return end
    local function paint(row, key, state)
        if not state then
            row.Text = key .. "   off"
            row.TextColor3 = CLR_MUTED
        else
            row.Text = key .. "   on"
            row.TextColor3 = CLR_ON
        end
    end
    paint(wmStatus.esp,    "esp",    espOn)
    paint(wmStatus.aim,    "aim",    aimOn)
    paint(wmStatus.smooth, "smooth", SMOOTH_ON)
end

    hopGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    hopGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    hopGui.DisplayOrder = 1001
    hopGui.Enabled = false
    hopGui.Parent = parentGui()

    local card = panel({
        parent = hopGui,
        size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 110),
        pos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 44),
        anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
        radius = 14,
        bgT = 0.1,
        strokeClr = CLR_ACCENT,
        strokeT = 0.3,
        strokeW = 1.5,
    })

    local title = label({
        parent = card, font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, size = 16,
        color = CLR_TEXT, text = "Change server?",

        dim = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 22),

    local sub = label({
        parent = card, font = Enum.Font.Gotham, size = 12,

    TweenService:Create(yes, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), {
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.35

local function showHop()
    if not hopGui then buildHopPrompt() end
    hopGui.Enabled = true
    hopOpen = true
end

local function hideHop()
    if hopGui then hopGui.Enabled = false end
    hopOpen = false
end

local function doHop()
    print("[neon team] looking for a server...")
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    local currentJob = game.JobId

    local url = string.format(
        "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100",
        placeId
    )

    local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url))
    end)

    if ok and decoded and decoded.data then
        local pool = {}
        for _, s in ipairs(decoded.data) do
            if s.id and s.id ~= currentJob and s.playing < s.maxPlayers then
                pool[#pool + 1] = s.id
            end
        end

        if #pool > 0 then
            local pick = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
            print("[neon team] hopping to " .. pick)
            local ok2 = pcall(function()
                TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, pick, LocalPlayer)
            end)
            if ok2 then return end
        else
            print("[neon team] no free servers, trying same place")
        end
    else
        print("[neon team] http failed, trying same place")
    end

    pcall(function()
        TeleportService:Teleport(placeId, LocalPlayer)
    end)
end

local function initKillSound()
    if killSoundInst then return end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "nt_killsound"
    s.SoundId = KILL_SOUND_ID
    s.Volume = KILL_SOUND_VOL
    s.PlayOnRemove = false
    s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
    s.RollOffMaxDistance = 10000
    s.RollOffMinDistance = 10
    s.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
    killSoundInst = s
end

local function playKillSound()
    if not killSoundInst then return end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        SoundService:PlayLocalSound(killSoundInst)
    end)
    if not ok or not killSoundInst.IsPlaying then
        pcall(function()
            killSoundInst:Stop()
            killSoundInst:Play()
        end)
    end
end

local function addHighlight(plr)
    if highlights[plr] and highlights[plr].Parent then return highlights[plr] end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return nil end

    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Name = "nt_esp"
    hl.FillColor = ESP_RED
    hl.OutlineColor = ESP_RED
    hl.FillTransparency = ESP_FILL
    hl.OutlineTransparency = ESP_OUTLINE
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.Adornee = char
    hl.Parent = char

    highlights[plr] = hl
    return hl
end

local function killHighlight(plr)
    local h = highlights[plr]
    if h then h:Destroy() end
    highlights[plr] = nil
end

local function clearHighlights()
    for _, h in pairs(highlights) do
        if h then h:Destroy() end
    end
    highlights = {}
end

local function addTag(plr)
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head or not hrp then return end

    local bbName = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bbName.Name = "nt_name"
    bbName.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 18)
    bbName.StudsOffset = TAG_NAME_OFFSET
    bbName.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bbName.Adornee = head
    bbName.Parent = head

    local nameLbl = label({
        parent = bbName, font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, size = 13,
        color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), text = plr.Name,
        x = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    })

    local bbDist = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bbDist.Name = "nt_dist"
    bbDist.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 16)
    bbDist.StudsOffset = TAG_DIST_OFFSET
    bbDist.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bbDist.Adornee = hrp
    bbDist.Parent = hrp

    local distLbl = label({
        parent = bbDist, font = Enum.Font.Code, size = 12,
        color = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220), text = "",
        x = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    })

    nameTags[plr] = {name = bbName, dist = bbDist, nameLbl = nameLbl, distLbl = distLbl}
end

local function killTag(plr)
    local t = nameTags[plr]
    if t then
        if t.name then t.name:Destroy() end
        if t.dist then t.dist:Destroy() end
    end
    nameTags[plr] = nil
end

local function clearTags()
    for _, t in pairs(nameTags) do
        if t.name then t.name:Destroy() end
        if t.dist then t.dist:Destroy() end
    end
    nameTags = {}
end

local function tickTags()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end
        if TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            killTag(plr)
            continue
        end

        local char = plr.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if char and head and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and myRoot then
            local dist = (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= ESP_RANGE then
                if not nameTags[plr] or not nameTags[plr].name.Parent then
                    killTag(plr)
                    addTag(plr)
                end
                local t = nameTags[plr]
                if t then
                    if t.name.Adornee ~= head then t.name.Adornee = head end
                    if t.dist.Adornee ~= hrp then t.dist.Adornee = hrp end
                    t.distLbl.Text = string.format("%d m", math.floor(dist))
                    local fade = math.clamp(dist / ESP_RANGE, 0, 1) * 0.4
                    t.nameLbl.TextTransparency = fade
                    t.distLbl.TextTransparency = fade
                end
            else
                killTag(plr)
            end
        else
            killTag(plr)
        end
    end
end

local function tickEsp()
    if not espOn then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end
    local myPos = myRoot.Position

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end

        if TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            killHighlight(plr)
            continue
        end

        local char = plr.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if char and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            local dist = (hrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
            if dist <= ESP_RANGE then
                local hl = addHighlight(plr)
                if hl and hl.Adornee ~= char then hl.Adornee = char end
                if hl then
                    local t = dist / ESP_RANGE
                    hl.FillTransparency = 0.4 + t * 0.4
                end
            else
                killHighlight(plr)
            end
        else
            killHighlight(plr)
        end
    end

    tickTags()
end

local function score(plr)
    local char = plr.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head or not hrp then return nil end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    local worldDist = (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
    if worldDist > AIM_MAX_DIST then return nil end

    local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
    if not onScreen then return nil end

    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local screenDist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
    if screenDist > AIM_FOV then return nil end

    local look = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local dir  = (head.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
    local dot  = look:Dot(dir)
    if dot < AIM_FRONT_BIAS then return nil end

    if AIM_WALL_CHECK then
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local ray = Ray.new(origin, head.Position - origin)
        local ignore = { LocalPlayer.Character, char }
        local hit = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, ignore, false, true)
        if hit then return nil end
    end

    return screenDist - dot * 200
end

local function bestTarget()
    local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer or not alive(plr) then continue end
        if AIM_TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then continue end
        local s = score(plr)
        if s and s < bestScore then
            bestScore = s
            best = plr
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function targetHead()
    if not target or not alive(target) then return nil end
    local char = target.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    return head and head.Position or nil
end

local function watchKills(plr)
    if plr == LocalPlayer then return end

    local function attach(char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hum then return end

        keep(hum.Died:Connect(function()
            local play = false

            if KILL_SOUND_MODE == "target" then
                if target == plr then play = true end
            elseif KILL_SOUND_MODE == "nearby" then
                local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if myRoot and hrp then
                    if (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= KILL_SOUND_RADIUS then
                        play = true
                    end
                end
            elseif KILL_SOUND_MODE == "confirm" then
                if target == plr and (tick() - lastShot) <= KILL_CONFIRM_WINDOW then
                    play = true
                end
            end

            if play then
                playKillSound()
                print("[neon team] kill: " .. plr.Name)
            end
        end))
    end

    if plr.Character then attach(plr.Character) end
    keep(plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(attach))
end

local function onJoin(plr)
    watchKills(plr)
    keep(plr.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        killHighlight(plr)
        killTag(plr)
        if target == plr then target = nil end
    end))
end

local function onLeave(plr)
    killHighlight(plr)
    killTag(plr)
    if target == plr then target = nil end
end

keep(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin))
keep(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onLeave))
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do onJoin(plr) end

local function shutdown()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    conns = {}

    clearHighlights()
    clearTags()

    if wmGui then wmGui:Destroy() wmGui = nil end
    if hopGui then hopGui:Destroy() hopGui = nil end
    if killSoundInst then killSoundInst:Destroy() killSoundInst = nil end

    espOn = false
    aimOn = false
    target = nil
    wmStatus = nil
    hopOpen = false

    print("[neon team] unloaded. cya.")
end

keep(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end

    if hopOpen then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
            hideHop()
            print("[neon team] hop cancelled")
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Y then
            hideHop()
            doHop()
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
            shutdown()
        end
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
        shutdown()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
        showHop()
        print("[neon team] hop prompt shown")

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
        espOn = not espOn
        if not espOn then
            clearHighlights()
            clearTags()
        end
        print("[neon team] esp " .. (espOn and "on" or "off"))
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        aimOn = not aimOn
        if aimOn then
            target = bestTarget()
            lastSwitch = tick()
            if target then
                print("[neon team] locked " .. target.Name)
            else
                print("[neon team] nothing visible in front")
                aimOn = false
            end
        else
            target = nil
            print("[neon team] unlocked")
        end
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K then
        SMOOTH_ON = not SMOOTH_ON
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth %s (%.2f)", SMOOTH_ON and "on" or "off", SMOOTH_FACTOR))
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket then
        SMOOTH_FACTOR = math.max(SMOOTH_MIN, SMOOTH_FACTOR - SMOOTH_STEP)
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth factor %.2f", SMOOTH_FACTOR))

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket then
        SMOOTH_FACTOR = math.min(SMOOTH_MAX, SMOOTH_FACTOR + SMOOTH_STEP)
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth factor %.2f", SMOOTH_FACTOR))
    end
end))

keep(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        lastShot = tick()
    end
end))

keep(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not espOn then return end
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastEspTick < ESP_REFRESH then return end
    lastEspTick = now
    pcall(tickEsp)
end))

keep(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not aimOn then return end
    local now = tick()

    if not target or not alive(target) or (now - lastSwitch >= AIM_SWITCH_DELAY) then
        local best = bestTarget()
        if best and best ~= target then
            target = best
            lastSwitch = now
        elseif not best then
            target = nil
            return
        end
    end

    local head = targetHead()
    if head then
        local desired = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, head)
        if SMOOTH_ON then
            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(desired, SMOOTH_FACTOR)
        else
            Camera.CFrame = desired
        end
    end
end))

initKillSound()
buildWatermark()
refreshStatus()
